title: Monthly climate, 1991-2020 normals and degree days by city
description:
Monthly climate from February 1950 to December 2025 for the largest cities, with 1991-2020 normals and degree days, computed from the daily ERA5-Land values.

Columns. tmean_c (°C), tmin_mean_c (°C), tmax_mean_c (°C), tmin_abs_c (°C), tmax_abs_c (°C), precip_mm (mm), wet_days (days), frost_days (days), hdd_15_5, hdd_18, cdd_18, cdd_22, gtz_20_15 (degree days, °C·day), solar_kwh_m2 (kWh/m²), wind_mean_kmh (km/h). Normals file 1991-2020 (12 rows per city): tmean_c, tmin_c, tmax_c, precip_mm, wet_days, frost_days, summer_days, hot_days, solar_kwh_m2_day, wind_mean_kmh, hdd_15_5, hdd_18, cdd_18.

Method. Copernicus ERA5-Land hourly reanalysis, 0.1° grid, nearest cell to the city point, local civil days (IANA time zone, complete days only). Temperatures are adjusted for altitude at 6.5 °C per km; precipitation is not adjusted.

Limits. Grid-cell reanalysis values, not station measurements. Hot days in city centres are undercounted. Degree days differ from figures published by national services.

Places. Cities from GeoNames (cities5000), CC BY 4.0, ranked by population: 100 each for the UK, Germany and France, 20 each for Portugal and Serbia, 5 for Luxembourg; city_id is the GeoNames id. Files are named <cc>_... per country (gb, de, fr, pt, lu, rs).
